analysis_type: memory-safe streaming equivalent of frozen deterministic post-processing
implementation_note: Transactions were processed one paired condition-seed group at a time because the frozen in-memory loader would require loading approximately 50.34 GB of transaction CSV input. The research definitions and frozen analysis functions were not changed.
important: These deterministic preservation tables do not alone establish overall CAPC success. Final conclusions require the predeclared paired uncertainty and inferential analyses.
starvation_rule: max(0.50 s, 5 x paired-baseline median waiting time)
